name: Gravity-Resistant Composite
description: A metamaterial composite whose internal structure partially decouples it from gravitational fields through quantum geometric effects. Objects made from GRC feel significantly lighter than their mass suggests, though they retain full inertia. Used in heavy-lift platforms and construction equipment to reduce energy costs of vertical movement.
story_hooks: The formula for GRC production is one of the most closely guarded trade secrets in the world — three researchers have disappeared after attempting to publish open-source synthesis routes.
